item.title: New Medical AI Safety Frameworks Address Personalized Guarding and Evidence Governance
item.description:
New Medical AI Safety Frameworks Address Personalized Guarding and Evidence Governance

Recent research introduces three frameworks advancing medical AI safety: personalized medication guarding with a new benchmark, evidence governance for tool-augmented agents, and a hindsight audit for diagnostic benchmarks.

#medical-ai #ai-safety #benchmarks #ai-agents #evidence-governance #personalized-medicine

Source: MedGuardBench: A Patient-Oriented Benchmark for Personalized Guardrail Development Source: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents Source: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
